about.title: About
about.subtitle: Engineer, author, builder
about.bio:
4th-year engineering student at INSA Hauts-de-France, pursuing a work-study engineering degree in computer science and cybersecurity (2024–2027). I work at the intersection of cybersecurity, full-stack development, and cloud architecture. Through my apprenticeship at SEMR (smartfone.fr / magicrecycle.com), I lead the Regeneration ERP, Scaleway infrastructure, and major e-commerce migrations.

On the ground: LanceOS (SaaS for freelancers), CTF practice (TryHackMe, 100+ challenges), and SIEM deployment (internship in Bucharest - Splunk, Wazuh).

Beyond code, I authored a book on personal discipline (MORSE), won the INSA Hauts-de-France eloquence contest 2025-2026, and placed 2nd nationally at Inter-INSA x VINCI 2026.

Three words: curious, organized, creative. One conviction: technical skill without vision is worthless.
